title: How out-of-home wins over winter travelers

facts.fact: Epsilon reports that the average consumer is expected to spend $782 this holiday season.
facts.quote: The average consumer is expected to spend $782 this holiday season, though many remain concerned about rising prices and tighter budgets, according to Epsilon.

facts.fact: In a NerdWallet and The Harris Poll survey, 45% of Americans plan to spend money on flights or hotels this holiday season.
facts.quote: 45% of Americans plan to spend money on flights or hotels this holiday season, spending $2,586 on average, for these expenses.

facts.fact: In the same NerdWallet and The Harris Poll survey, those planning flight or hotel spending expect to spend $2,586 on average on these expenses.
facts.quote: spending $2,586 on average, for these expenses

facts.fact: According to new research from Adweek and The Weather Company, campaigns that match a consumer's weather-related mindset can lift purchase intent by 10%.
